description: This file defines a constant reference and a function to apply configuration related to FAL (likely a model or service) in an OpenClaw project. It modifies the configuration by setting a default image generation model if not already specified.

methods.name: export function applyFalConfig(cfg: OpenClawConfig): OpenClawConfig { applyFalConfig
methods.description: Modifies the OpenClawConfig object by setting a default imageGenerationModel if it is not already present.

calls: return { ...cfg, agents: { ...cfg.agents, defaults: { ...cfg.agents?.defaults, imageGenerationModel: { primary: FAL_DEFAULT_IMAGE_MODEL_REF } } } }
